boundary_evidence: The class's complete member set in one contiguous run: the four field accessors (centre copy-out, radius store, compound Set, centre store) tile 0x0203abb0..0x0203ac1c and the five retained ABI variants (D2,D0,D1,C1,C2) tile 0x0203ac1c..0x0203ac80. PathPtr's FromIDE begins the next TU at 0x0203ac80; dBgW_KcMbgSclY's own members end at 0x0203abb0.
include/dM3dGSph.h already carries the class (Vector3 centre at 0x04, Fix12i radius at 0x10, size 0x14 asserted) with the same func_ -> member mapping recorded as a comment before this fold.

compiler_only_output.reason: Vector3's four-byte inline destructor, emitted as vague linkage because the accessors take Vector3 references. The cartridge owns it at arm9:0x020072c0 and an enrolled source already reaches it, so this object's copy is a duplicate that production isolation discards.

The destructor is the key function, so the TU emits the class's two-slot vtable (D1, D0). The cartridge copy lives at arm9:0x020994cc -- the _ZTV8dM3dGSph alias the C1 vptr store relocates against -- and romdata_check proves every slot before isolation discards this copy.

Emitted with the vtable group for the same key-function reason; the cartridge's single-inheritance record is arm9:0x020992e4 and its two relocations (abi class vptr, _ZTS8dM3dGSph) are proved by romdata_check.
The emitted type-name string equals the cartridge's record at arm9:0x020992ec -- the class carries the ROM's own dM3dGSph spelling, not a coined name -- so the copy is discarded after proof.

notes: The four accessors were anonymous func_ shards because the class is only ever reached through base pointers and members: dBgW_KcMbgSclY::DetectClsn reads the centre out, and dBgCh_Lin::SetObjAndLine plus dBgCh_SphCrr::SetObjAndSphere write centre+radius through Set. symbols.txt now names them by their member spellings (_ZNK8dM3dGSph9GetCentreER7Vector3, _ZN8dM3dGSph9SetRadiusEi, _ZN8dM3dGSph3SetERK7Vector3i, _ZN8dM3dGSph9SetCentreERK7Vector3) and the three callers call them as methods.

All five ABI variants are cartridge-retained: dBgCh_SphCrr constructs the sphere as a non-primary base (calls C2, destroys via D2) while dBgCh_Lin constructs mBoundSphere as a complete member (C1, D1). Deferred codegen emits D2,D0,D1 then C1,C2, matching the ROM order.
